Do not mirror or duplicate the original composition to fake the extension. Do not add characters, people, creatures, text, UI, logos, watermarks, borders, black bars or blank gutters. A luminous pale ivory full moon, cropped by the upper and right borders in the original, against softly painted coral, peach and rose clouds. Continue the single moon's round curve naturally as necessary, and expand the atmospheric pink cloud sky out to the left and right. One single moon only. Soft elegant nostalgic anime atmosphere; keep the original gentle low-contrast glow and painterly cloud detail. No stars or architecture unless already present.
